items.title: Juicy Yields Draw Junk Bond Buyers to Investment-Grade AI Debt
items.summary: Companies looking to finance data center projects are increasingly turning to junk bond investors to help them raise billions of dollars, even for debt that is investment-grade.

items.title: BTW: Headlines You May Have Missed
items.summary: LinkedIn becoming a dating site, ghost jobs, fun at home, and farmers saying no to data centers: Alexis Christoforous joins David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend to share headlines from this week that may have gone under the radar. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: The AI Spending Spree Comes With a Catch
items.summary: Sam Palmisano says the AI boom is built on long-cycle bets in data centers, chips and energy, even as AI software changes at breakneck speed. If adoption slows or cheaper Chinese open-source models gain traction, Big Tech may have to rethink the spending plans behind today’s AI race. (Source: Bloomberg)
